notes.title: Update and a release date for the DLC
notes.content:
Originally, I was planning on releasing the DLC today, but my integrated graphics card overheated and that caused my previous laptop to not be able to start and the laptop was not worth repairing.

With all my files on that laptop, that put a wrench in my plans.

Don't worry, I got all the files back and everything back in order so you can expect the free DLC to be released on the February 7th. 

Cheers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41659286/b038806d35316c26baf8fc34e3cb2d6967944a8d.gif[/img]

notes.title: Release date of Freedom's eye
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I have decided to delay the realase of Freedom's eye to June 20th .
The 2 reasons for the delay are :
1.Unexpected audio and visual bugs(primarly on low spec devices).
2.Some much needed improvment to the visuals of the game.
As you can see (the last gif in the game description),the diffrence between the original planned look and current look is night and day.


My main thoughts are that, in the end, I want to realease the game that I am proud of and everyone can enjoy so I hope you can wait a little longer.

Hope everyone is doing well, cheers.
